Marcus —

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard Lumina Labs as a Redwood vendor. To finish activation on our side we need: a completed vendor onboarding form, W-9 (or local tax form), and your bank wiring/ACH remit instructions. I attached our vendor onboarding template and a PO labeling example to show how we place PO numbers on remits.

Quick asks: 
- Please confirm ACH (routing + last 4) and wire (SWIFT) details. You can mask the account number in email and attach a PDF with the full details.
- Confirm the preferred remittance field for PO numbers ("Payment Reference" vs invoice memo). We prefer PO in a discrete field so our AP system can auto-attach.
- Any special invoice header format (company name mismatch, VAT ID) we should expect?

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboard_form.pdf, PO_labeling_example.csv

Goal: have vendor activated for PO issuance on Monday (2025-05-12) and a first test remittance thereafter.

Thanks — I copied Jordan in Finance to move the micro-deposit and verification along.

Appreciate the clear checklist. Attached are the items you requested: Lumina_W9.pdf and Lumina_BANK_DETAILS.pdf (bank details PDF is the official banking letter from our bank). A few quick notes: 

- ACH: Account ending in ••67 (routing 044000137).
- Wire (USD): Swift = BOFAUS3N (Bank of America correspondent), intermediary CHIPS info included in the attached PDF.
- For remittance mapping, our AP team prefers a single remittance field labelled PAYMENT_REF. If you need the PO number in a separate field we can supply PO metadata on the remittance stub; see sample column headers in Lumina_BANK_DETAILS.pdf.
- Lumina's invoice header sometimes uses our legal entity: Lumina Labs, Inc. VAT/tax ID included on W-9 for US vendors.

Attachments: Lumina_W9.pdf, Lumina_BANK_DETAILS.pdf

We can accept a test ACH micro-deposit to verify routing — let us know amount and date window and we'll confirm.
